question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Repulsive
solution:
The correct answer is '**Pleasant**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Repulsive**' is '**Pleasant**'.
 
• **Repulsive**: causing intense disgust or aversion; very unpleasant. (Hindi: घृणित) 
 
 
• *Example: The smell from the garbage was so **repulsive** that I had to hold my breath.*
 
 
 
• **Pleasant**: giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment; nice. (Hindi: सुखद)
 
 
• *Example: The view of the sunset over the ocean was so **pleasant** that I couldn't help but smile.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Pleasant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Steadfast**: resolutely or dutifully firm and unwavering. (Hindi: दृढ़)
 
• **Superfluous**: unnecessary, especially through being more than enough. (Hindi: अतिरिक्त) 
 
• **Hopeless**: feeling or causing despair about something; impossible to solve or achieve. (Hindi: निराशाजनक)
